_meta.description: Parametric design templates for common 3D printable objects. Each template provides OpenSCAD code with customizable parameters.

phone_stand.description: Holds a phone at a set viewing angle on a desk. Give it your phone's width and the angle you want. Prints upright, no supports.

hook.description: Wall hook with screw hole. Prints on its side as an extruded profile — no supports, layer lines wrap the J for strength.

cable_clip.description: Holds one to four cable runs against a desk or wall — cables snap into C-channels above a flat stick-down pad. Set the cable diameter. Prints as an extruded profile, no supports.

shelf_bracket.description: Shelf bracket with a real diagonal brace. Prints lying flat as an extruded profile; brace loads run along the layers.

drawer_organizer.description: Divides a drawer into a grid of compartments. Set the drawer's width and depth and how many columns and rows you want. Prints as an open tray, no supports.

sd_card_holder.description: Desktop holder for SD and microSD cards in two rows of top-opening slots; cards stand proud for easy grip. No supports.

coat_hook_multi.description: Wall-mounted coat rack with multiple pegs. Prints flat on its back, pegs up, no supports.

hinge_box.description: Small-parts box that prints as one flat piece and folds shut on a living hinge. Set the box width, depth, and height. No supports.

funnel.description: Decants liquids or powders into a narrow opening. Set the mouth and spout diameters to match what you're pouring into. Prints mouth-down on a full rim ring, no supports.

spout_dia.description: Spout bore diameter (outer is bore + 2 x wall)

measuring_scoop.description: Kitchen measuring scoop: cylindrical cup holding exactly the set volume when filled level, with a flat handle. Prints without supports.

wall_plate_cover.description: Replaces a broken or mismatched switch plate. Pick single toggle, double toggle, or outlet, and set the plate size. Prints flat, no supports.

soap_dish.description: Draining soap dish with raised ridges in the basin and a protruding front-center drain spout that channels water off the front edge.

ridge_count.description: Number of raised drain ridges in basin

spout_width.description: Width of the protruding drain spout

spout_length.description: How far the drain spout extends beyond the front edge (set to 0 for no spout — closed basin)

spool_holder.description: Bench stand a filament spool rides on: two smooth half-round rails lift the spool clear of the base so it can rotate, side walls keep it from walking off the ends. One piece, prints without supports.

roller_dia.description: Rail diameter the spool rides on

tube_connector.description: Joins two tubes or pipes end to end, straight or at a bend angle you set. The sleeve slips over both ends — size it from the tube's outer diameter. Straight couplers print support-free; steep bends need supports.

battery_holder.description: Battery tray for AA, AAA, or 18650 cells. Snap-in trough lips and a finger scoop; prints without supports.

wrench.description: Open-ended wrench sized to one hex bolt. Give the across-flats size; jaw and handle print flat as one piece.

spacer_washer.description: Sets a gap in a bolted stack, or spreads load like a washer. Set the hole, outer diameter, and thickness. Prints flat, no supports.

corner_brace.description: Reinforces a right-angle joint in a frame or box. L bracket with screw holes through both arms — set the arm length, hole size, and holes per arm.

standoff.description: Holds a board or panel a set distance off its mounting surface. Hex body with a screw through-hole; set the height and hex across-flats.

shaft_collar.description: Locks a position on a round shaft. Split ring that a cross bolt pinches shut — set the shaft diameter and bolt size.

pcb_standoff_mount.description: Mounts a bare PCB inside an enclosure or on a panel. Base plate with four screw posts — set the board's hole-to-hole spacing.

din_rail_clip.description: Puts a custom module on a 35 mm DIN rail. Back plate with lipped grips at both rail edges and a flat face to mount to; set the mounting face size.

servo_bracket.description: Holds a hobby servo against a frame or panel. U-channel around the servo body with a screwed-down base flange — set your servo's body dimensions.

stackable_bin.description: Stackable storage bin with interlocking lip and a card-pocket label holder. Prints without supports.

threaded_jar.description: Jar with a real swept helical screw thread and a lid with the matching internal thread. Two-piece print, threads engage with 0.25 mm radial clearance.

monitor_riser_shelf.description: Monitor riser shelf. Prints upside down (shelf on the bed, legs up), no supports; flip over to use.

tablet_stand.description: Holds a tablet or e-reader at a set viewing angle, with a charging-cable notch through the back. Prints upright, no supports.

drill_bit_holder.description: Stands a drill bit set upright in size order — holes step evenly from your smallest bit to your largest. Set the size range and count.

hex_key_rack.description: Wall rack that holds an Allen key set in size order, slots stepping evenly from the smallest key to the largest. Set the size range and count.

sanding_block.description: Hand block for sanding flat. Sandpaper tucks into a slot at each end and a finger recess sits on top — size the block to the paper you cut.

bag_clip.description: Bag clip in two flat parts: fold-over clip with living hinge, plus a slider ring that locks it shut. Prints flat, no supports.

spice_jar_rack.description: Brings a back row of spice jars into view on a stepped rack. Set your jar diameter, jars per row, and number of rows. Prints without supports.

bottle_opener.description: Pops a crown cap — hooked lever head sized to the standard 26.5 mm cap, with a grip handle. Prints flat, no supports.

filament_guide.description: Filament guide that slides onto printer frame extrusions. Prints flat as an extruded profile, no supports.

nozzle_rack.description: Keeps spare nozzles from rolling away, standing each one upright in its own hex socket. Set the slot count and nozzle hex size.

cable_raceway_clip.description: Snap-in cable clip. Prints as an extruded profile, no supports, with layer lines wrapping the C for spring strength.

cable_grommet.description: Desk grommet ring with cable slot and snap ring. Prints flange-down, no supports.

gopro_mount.description: Standard GoPro 3-finger mount base with teardrop pivot hole. Prints without supports.

vesa_adapter.description: Bolts a monitor with one VESA pattern to an arm with another — one plate drilled with both hole patterns. Set the two spacings. Prints flat, no supports.

rail_clamp.description: Split-ring rail clamp with cross bolt and mounting pad. Prints as an extruded profile, no supports.

plant_label_stake.description: Pointed garden stake with raised-text label. Prints lying flat, so soil-push loads run along the layers.

pot_drip_tray.description: Catches runoff under a plant pot. Saucer sized to your pot's base diameter plus a margin you set. Prints as an open tray, no supports.

seed_spacer.description: Lays out a seed bed at even spacing — a flat template you press into soil and plant through. Set the grid spacing and hole count.

phone_vent_mount.description: Car vent phone mount in two flat parts: cradle plus a vent fin that locks through the cradle's slot. No supports.

fuse_puller.description: Tweezer-style fuse puller. Prints lying flat, so the arms flex along the layers instead of prying them apart.

corner_clamp_jig.description: Holds two workpieces square while glue sets. Inside corner with fences along both arms on a braced base plate — set the arm length to the stock you're joining.

bench_dog.description: Bench dog with friction-fit spring slot. Prints head-down with a 45-degree flare, no supports.

hose_barb_adapter.description: Barbed fitting adapting between two hose diameters. Diamond barbs and coned transitions print support-free.

drain_strainer.description: Drain strainer with radial slots and a coned rim that self-centers in the drain. Prints without supports.

raspberry_pi_case.description: Two-part Raspberry Pi case; base and lid print side by side with open faces up, no supports. Standoffs follow the official 58x49mm hole pattern.

switch_panel.description: Front panel for a row of toggle or rocker switches, with corner mounting holes. Set the switch hole diameter, count, and spacing. Prints flat, no supports.

p_trap_cover.description: Hides the exposed P-trap under a sink. Lipped panel with a pipe pass-through at the bottom — set the panel size and pipe diameter. Prints flat, no supports.

shower_caddy_hook.description: Hangs a caddy or towel off a shower pipe. C-clamp that snaps over the pipe with a curled hook arm — set the pipe's outer diameter. Prints as an extruded profile, no supports.

cable_chain_link.description: Snap-together cable chain link with an open cable channel and pivot pins. Prints floor-down, no supports.

cable_wrap_guide.description: Cable spool in two parts printed side by side; the mounting screw clamps the top flange onto the hub. No supports.

clamp_pad.description: Soft jaw pad that slips over metal vise jaws. Prints face-down, no supports.

dowel_jig.description: Drills a row of dowel holes in line. Guide block with a reference groove that registers on the workpiece edge — set the dowel diameter, hole count, and spacing.

birdhouse_panel.description: Birdhouse front panel with entry hole and integrated perch. Prints flat on its back, no supports.

gear_spur.description: Spur gear for a hobby mechanism or robot. Set the tooth count, module, and bore; it meshes with any gear of the same module. Prints flat, no supports.

pulley_gt2.description: Drives a 2 mm-pitch GT2 belt on a printer or CNC axis. Flanged barrel with simplified tooth grooves — set the tooth count and shaft bore. Prints without supports.

z_axis_guide.description: Carries a Z endstop switch on a printer's 2020 frame. Clamp body slides in the extrusion slot with a switch platform beside it — set the switch width.

tool_holder_pegboard.description: Pegboard hook for a tool, cable, or accessory, on the standard 25 mm peg spacing, with an upturned tip that keeps the tool on. Prints flat, no supports.

fridge_magnet.description: Flat magnet holder in rectangle, square, circle, or oval shapes with recess for a standard disc magnet. Front face is decoration-ready for photos, logos, or text.

shape.description: Shape: rectangle, square, circle, or oval

bookmark.description: Thin flat bookmark with an optional page-edge hook and a decoration-ready face. Prints flat at thin-wall thickness.

pen_cup.description: Desktop pen/pencil holder in cylinder or rectangular shape. Flat outer walls for decoration (logo, text, photo). Bottom has a recessed QR code pocket matching the proven coaster recipe.

depth.description: Depth/length for rectangular shape (ignored for cylinder)

qr_pocket_size.description: QR code pocket size on bottom (0 = no pocket). Must be less than 75% of diameter.

qr_pocket_depth.description: QR pocket recess depth (matches coaster recipe)
